answer.rationale: With only 14 days to expiry and the line at 94% of committed volume, continuity risk rules out an unverified primary-source switch or a sourcing change that could disrupt deliveries. Verify the prior benchmark-led renewal and multi-year volume-pricing records, then negotiate an incumbent renewal that targets the 18% spend reduction through market benchmarking, volume tiers, and payment terms while preserving supply continuity. The final savings commitment remains conditional on verified incumbent capacity, pricing, and contract flexibility.
